traits.name: Envenom
traits.text: ⬻ Frequency once per day Effect Using either saliva or blood, the vishkanya applies vishkanyan venom to one weapon they're holding. To use their blood, they must be injured, or they can deal themselves 1 slashing damage as part of the action.

traits.name: Flexible
traits.text: The vishkanya infiltrator is adept at dealing with tight situations. They have a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Escape.

traits.name: Proficient Poisoner
traits.text: The vishkanya infiltrator doesn't lose the poison on a weapon due to a critically failed Strike.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The vishkanya deals 1d6 (1d6) extra precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Vishkanyan Venom
traits.text: (injury, poison); Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d4 (1d4) poison damage (1 round) Stage 2 1d4 (1d4) poison damage and flat-footed (1 round) Stage 3 1d4 (1d4) poison damage, flat-footed, and a –5-foot penalty to Speed (1 round)
